about_the_game:
Command powerful creatures and channel dark magic with gear tailored for masters of summoning.

The Summoner Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original is crafted for those who bend otherworldly forces to their will. Whether conjuring beasts from the void or unleashing curses upon enemies, this set empowers summoners to dominate the battlefield with control, chaos, and raw magical force.

Includes the following exclusive arcane items:

  • Mysterious Magic Wand – A focused conduit ideal for rapid summoning incantations and magical support spells.

  • Mysterious Magic Staff – A powerful staff designed to amplify summoning magic and enhance creature control.

  • Mysterious Magic Book – A tome filled with forbidden knowledge, increasing the potency and duration of summoned entities.

Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Set:

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Cap

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Chest

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Leggings

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Gloves

  • Brutal Massacring Thick Leather Boots

A rugged and aggressive leather armor set that balances mobility with magical defense, built for summoners who fight alongside their monstrous allies.

Unleash devastation through your minions and lead your horde to victory. The Summoner Equipment Package is your gateway to untamed magical domination in 4Story: The Original.

*You must enter the game, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to receive the set item.
